queue.title: The new safety check watches the game pick its background settings at the moment you land, but stops there by design - it says nothing about what happens when you walk across into the next section. That crossing is still unwatched, and now that a real authored band exists there is something worth watching. Small and self-contained.

The assembler warns you when it might not match its own source. It fires on every paired landing, because refreezing dirties the tree it then builds in. The assembler lane is keeping it loud on purpose: a version that stays quiet during refreezes would also stay quiet if a real source edit rode along with one. Booked there, not here.

awaiting: your answers on the decision cards, three of which actually gate work; the rest are cheap
